name: rosetta-strip-a-set-of-characters-from-a-string
code:
use default

strip(text: string, unwanted: string) -> string =>
    string(text |> filter(c => unwanted.index_of(c) < 0) |> collect_array())

write_line(strip("She was a soul stripper. She took my heart!", "aei"))

use default

strip(text: string, unwanted: string) -> string =>
